capabilities: Chat with AI models in a multi-tab interface
Save chat history as searchable markdown files in the vault
Clip text selections to summarize or explain with AI
extras: Closed source, commercial plugin: core features are free to try on an evaluation basis, but a one-time license purchase is required for continued use; unlicensed users get periodic reminders. Roadmap mentions Gemini and Anthropic support, text-to-speech input, and chat with notes as future work.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI chat interface or way to run AI workflows alongside note-taking.

relations.evidence: Leverage multiple AI providers, including OpenAI and local Ollama

summary: AI chat and knowledge copilot that adds multi-tab AI chat, prompt snippets, and chat history saved as local markdown files.
